description: The output a function-calling-optimized model returns for the weather query: valid JSON that names the tool and its argument, ready to parse and execute.

steps.description: This is the output from a function-calling-optimized model, the page's example being `hermes3:8b`. It is valid JSON conforming to the tool schema, so the agent framework can parse, validate, and execute it directly.
The `tool_call` object names the tool to run: `get_weather`, the function defined in the previous block.
The `arguments` object supplies the one required parameter, `city`, set to `"Philadelphia"`. That is the value the framework passes to the tool.

steps.question: The page says a 7B model fine-tuned for function calling reliably outperforms what on structured tool-call tasks?

title: A Parseable Tool-Call Output
